account_sid.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the SipDomain resource.

api_version.description: The API version used to process the call.

auth_type.description: The types of authentication you have mapped to your domain. Can be: `IP_ACL` and `CREDENTIAL_LIST`. If you have both defined for your domain, both will be returned in a comma delimited string. If `auth_type` is not defined, the domain will not be able to receive any traffic.

date_created.description: The date and time in GMT that the resource was created specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

date_updated.description: The date and time in GMT that the resource was last updated specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

domain_name.description: The unique address you reserve on Twilio to which you route your SIP traffic. Domain names can contain letters, digits, and "-" and must end with `sip.twilio.com`.

friendly_name.description: The string that you assigned to describe the resource.

sid.description: The unique string that that we created to identify the SipDomain resource.

uri.description: The URI of the resource, relative to `https://api.twilio.com`.

voice_fallback_method.description: The HTTP method we use to call `voice_fallback_url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST`.

voice_fallback_url.description: The URL that we call when an error occurs while retrieving or executing the TwiML requested from `voice_url`.

voice_method.description: The HTTP method we use to call `voice_url`. Can be: `GET` or `POST`.

voice_status_callback_method.description: The HTTP method we use to call `voice_status_callback_url`. Either `GET` or `POST`.

voice_status_callback_url.description: The URL that we call to pass status parameters (such as call ended) to your application.

voice_url.description: The URL we call using the `voice_method` when the domain receives a call.

subresource_uris.description: A list of mapping resources associated with the SIP Domain resource identified by their relative URIs.

sip_registration.description: Whether to allow SIP Endpoints to register with the domain to receive calls.

emergency_calling_enabled.description: Whether emergency calling is enabled for the domain. If enabled, allows emergency calls on the domain from phone numbers with validated addresses.

secure.description: Whether secure SIP is enabled for the domain. If enabled, TLS will be enforced and SRTP will be negotiated on all incoming calls to this sip domain.

byoc_trunk_sid.description: The SID of the BYOC Trunk(Bring Your Own Carrier) resource that the Sip Domain will be associated with.

emergency_caller_sid.description: Whether an emergency caller sid is configured for the domain. If present, this phone number will be used as the callback for the emergency call.
